title: A Note on the Irrationality of $\zeta(2)$ and $\zeta(3)$
container-title: Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society
note: Bull. London Math. Soc. 11(3) (1979), 268-272. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1112/blms/11.3.268) (2026-11-28). Re-proves Apéry's irrationality of zeta(2) and zeta(3) via Legendre-polynomial multiple integrals on [0,1]^2 and [0,1]^3, exhibiting the exact lcm(1..n)^s denominator-growth threshold.
